fact_text: Under the Finance Act 2026, banks and e-money institutions must report every transaction above Rs 10 million to the FBR central data hub, which is matched against taxpayers' declared details to act on suspected under-declaration.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Oil marketing company margins were about 2% of product price, roughly Rs 7.87 per litre, and were unchanged from September 2023 through FY24 to FY26, which OMCs cite in seeking an increase.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tighter OMC stock-cover requirements and daily fuel price changes add compliance burden, and OMCs tie their acceptance of these rules to margin compensation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petroleum dealer and OMC margins are set by government decision through the cabinet's Economic Coordination Committee, not by market pricing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petrol dealers used a threatened halt in fuel sales to pressure the government into a margin increase, which suggests supply-stoppage threats are a recurring lever in margin negotiations.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A cap on refinery margins means refineries keep profit only up to a set level, and because much of the diesel from local refineries goes to OMCs, the cap passes through to diesel prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's five national refineries together exported about $1.046 billion in FY26, the first time refinery exports passed $1 billion in a year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refinery exports of about $1.05 billion were roughly 3.5% of Pakistan's national exports of about $30 billion in FY26.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PARCO exported about $277 million of refined product in FY26, the largest single contribution among the national refineries cited in the report.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Refinery Limited exported about $258 million in FY26, the second national refinery export figure cited after PARCO.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's pipeline gas import price from Iran is linked to crude oil, so the import cost rises when crude rises.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Implementation of the Iran-Pakistan gas pipeline deal is conditional on US permission or sanctions relief for Iran, so its timing depends on US-Iran diplomacy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's plan to take smaller volumes of Iranian gas reflects its existing LNG imports from Qatar and domestic production, so Iranian pipeline gas would be a supplement rather than the main source.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A refinery policy that lets refineries sign upgrade agreements is expected to unlock several billion dollars of investment in upgrading local refineries.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '1 Billion Dollar Export Record, Iran-Pakistan Gas Pipeline - Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)
